transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in today?

I’ve lost all interest in my jewelry work and the things I used to love, and I just can't make myself care enough to keep the shop going. Everything feels so heavy, and I don't know how to get back to the way I was.
Have you had episodes like this before, and if so, how many and how long did they last?

No, I've never experienced anything like this before; this is my first time going through it. It all started about two years ago after my husband's health complications began, and it has just been ongoing since then.
Have you felt any pleasure at all in activities you once enjoyed, even small moments, or has the lack of interest been complete since your husband’s illness began?

The lack of interest has felt complete, and I just feel flat and numb all the time now. Even when I force myself to open a tray of gemstones or go to my book club, I feel totally detached, like I'm just watching someone else's life. This has been constant for over a year now, getting worse as my husband's health has declined.
Have you experienced any persistent sadness, feelings of worthlessness, or thoughts that life isn’t worth living since your husband became ill?

Yes, most days I wake up with this heavy, gray feeling and a constant guilt that I'm just a useless burden to my husband. It gets so dark that I sometimes think it would be a relief if I didn't wake up at all. I've even gone as far as counting the leftover pain pills in the bathroom, though I haven't actually done anything.
